Bid Title: Consultant Services For: HOME and CDBG LOAN PORTFOLIO MANAGEMENT
Description:
The County of Lake is inviting sealed proposals for informal written quotes for ongoing HOME and CDBG loan portfolio management, the current loan portfolio contains 54 loans.
Objectives: Contractor will provide general management for the County of Lake's HOME Investment Partnerships Program (HOME) and Community Development Block Grant (CDBG) loan portfolio. Proposals should be submitted in accordance with the requirements of this solicitation, which are contained herein.
(See attached PDF for Scope of Services and other relative information.)
Miscellaneous: Proposals whether submitted electronically or via hard copy must be received no later than Thursday November 27, 2025, by 4:00 p.m.

Bid Title: Consultant Services To Obtain Prohousing Designation
Description: The County of Lake is inviting sealed proposals for the development of an implementation plan to obtain the Prohousing Designation. This Plan will be created with input from County Staff and Community Engagement. The objective of this project is to obtain the Prohousing Designation by taking steps to increase the availability of housing such as streamlining permitting process, rezoning, incentive programs, etc.
Contact Person:
Deputy County Administrative Officer –
Housing, Lisa Judd: Lisa.Judd@lakecountyca.gov

Description:
NOTICE OF REQUEST FOR QUALIFICATIONS
CONSTRUCTION MANAGEMENT ON-CALL SERVICES
FOR
COUNTY OF LAKE DEPARTMENT OF PUBLIC WORKS
LAKE COUNTY, CA
SOLICITATION NO. 261482
The County of Lake is requesting Statements of Qualifications (SOQs) from qualified firms or individuals to provide on-call Construction Management services under a master agreement to support the efforts of the County departments. Work may include a full range of construction project management, construction oversight, inspection, and project close out.
SOQs must be received at or before 3:00 p.m. (local time) on Monday, December 1, 2025.
SUBMITTAL INSTRUCTIONS
1. Email submissions shall be sent to the following email address:

2. The subject line of the email should read “STATEMENT OF QUALIFICATIONS FOR ON-CALL CONSTRUCTION MANAGEMENT SERVICES FOR (FIRM NAME)”
3. The submission must be received no later than the day and time shown on the RFQ cover page.
4. Please email
For security reasons, you must enable JavaScript to view this E-mail address.
to confirm the County has received your submission. If Consultant does not receive an email confirming County’s receipt of the SOQ, call 707-263-2341 to confirm that the County received the SOQ. County encourages consultants to submit SOQ before noon on the date due.
5. Late submittals will not be considered.
SCOPE OF WORK
The scope of work, in general, includes all professional services associated with administration and construction management services for these projects in conformance with FHWA, Caltrans, and County requirements. The selected firm shall provide a field site representative who is a licensed professional civil engineer in the State of California and will function as the Resident Engineer.
